Thank you both for the time. CARE Esthetics is a new service line, performed by the Dean Dental team. Before prices, capacity and plans are locked in, the most valuable thing we can do is find out who actually wants which treatments, and build a list of people ready to book. In a few minutes I'll show how atLocal does that differently from a traditional agency, then walk through the eight-week test.
The problem

Three things stand between CARE and a full schedule.

The team is ready. The demand isn't proven yet, and every week without a list is a week of open appointments.

1

Nobody knows CARE yet

It's brand new. Outside the practice, people haven't heard of it.

2

Demand is a guess

No proof yet of which treatments people want, or how many will book.

3

Open slots cost money

Every empty appointment is time the team can't get back.

02
Three problems, in order of urgency. One: nobody knows CARE yet; it's brand new, and outside the practice people haven't heard of it. Two: demand is a guess; we don't know which treatments people want or how many will book. Three: open slots cost money; every empty appointment is time the team can't get back. This plan solves all three, starting with the list.

[Click 1: the tools become a chain. Click 2: the outcome.] Ads, SEO, posts, a website, a landing page, booking software: all useful, none of them fills a schedule on its own. For CARE, the system is a high trust video, boosted in North Little Rock and Central Arkansas, sending people to a sign-up page where they tell us which treatment they want and when. High trust videos
A real client shares her final PRF under-eye results, with her before photo. Public TikTok (@michellesays), shown as an example.
07
This is what a high trust video looks like in the wild. Two public TikToks, shown only as examples of the format: first, Peer, a real client sharing her final PRF under-eye results; second (tap the tab), Credibility, a nurse injector explaining why PRF works. CARE's videos would use two avatars: Peer, local people curious about the same treatment, and Credibility, the Dean Dental team who will actually perform it. The starting offer: "Something new from the Dean Dental team. Join the CARE Esthetics list and be first in line." We'll refine it together. We use plain treatment names, never trademarked ones, never promise results, and every claim is reviewed before use.
How we keep score

Two numbers tell us if it's working.

QPC

Qualified Prospect Count

How many people in North Little Rock and Central Arkansas joined the list for a specific treatment.

CPP

Cost per (qualified) Prospect

What it cost to produce each qualified sign-up. It shows what a full schedule will cost to fill.

CARE is new, so there's no past benchmark. At kickoff we confirm together:

Treatments to testWhat counts as "qualified"What counts as "ready to book"Measurement window
08
QPC, Qualified Prospect Count: people inside North Little Rock and Central Arkansas who joined the list for a specific treatment. CPP: what each of those sign-ups cost. Together they tell CARE how much demand there is and what it will cost to fill a schedule. There's no historical benchmark because CARE is new, so at kickoff we agree the treatments to test, what counts as qualified and as ready to book, and the measurement window.
Week to week

Test small. Back the winners.

1

Film

The atLocal Collective recruits 8 to 10 local creators (about 1,500 followers each). The Dean Dental team films its own high trust videos.

2

Post to followers

Creators are paid to post to their own followers, and Dean Dental shares with its patients, testing the content first.

3

Read the response

Watch time, shares, comments and saves. Change one thing at a time: avatar, message, treatment or area.

4

Back the winners

Paid distribution in North Little Rock first, then across Central Arkansas. Nowhere else.

5

Capture interest

Sign-up page with a longer high trust video and a short form: which treatment, and when. Every sign-up tracked.

6

Book the list

The Dean Dental team follows up and books the list as appointments open.

09
[Each click lights the next step; six clicks.] One: the atLocal Collective recruits 8 to 10 local creators, and the Dean Dental team films its own high trust videos. Two: creators are paid to post to their own followers, and the practice shares with its patients. Three: we measure, changing one thing at a time. Four: only proven videos get paid distribution, in North Little Rock first, then Central Arkansas. Five: viewers land on a sign-up page with a longer high trust video and tell us which treatment and when. Six: the Dean Dental team follows up and books the list as appointments open.
Where the ads run

Close to home, then wider

1

Start close to home

North Little Rock first, around the practice. Central Arkansas next. Nowhere else.

2

Draw the zones

Zone 1 is North Little Rock. Zone 2 is the rest of Central Arkansas: Conway, Cabot, Benton and the towns between.

3

Reach phones inside the zones

People whose phones are inside those areas see the proven high trust videos.

4

Spend only on proven videos

The videos that won the creator test are the ones boosted.

5

Warm them up with a high trust video

The ad click opens a longer high trust video: what the treatment is, what the visit is like, and the familiar team behind it.

6

Send them to one next step

Right under the video: join the list, with the treatment they want and when.

7

Compare the zones

Qualified sign-ups and cost per sign-up for each area and treatment. Budget moves toward what fills the schedule.

10
[Click 1: steps 1–3. Click 2: steps 4–7.] This is the how behind "boost winners." We start in North Little Rock, around the practice, then expand across Central Arkansas, and that's the whole footprint for now. We draw digital boundaries, and ads reach phones inside them. Only videos that proved themselves get spend. The ad click opens a longer high trust video, and right under it is one next step: join the list. We measure sign-ups and cost per sign-up by area and treatment, and move budget toward what fills the schedule. Fence size, timing and budget split are set together at Align. Targeting is geographic only, never based on personal health data.

The atLocal Collective

Our local creator network. Every sign-up traced to a face.

1

Credible avatars, per channel

We recruit local creators CARE's clients relate to on sight, not from a general pool. atLocal approves every one.

2

Their own landing page

Each creator gets CARE's sign-up page with their name on it. Every sign-up through it is credited to them.

3

Tracking that holds up

Bots never count as people, repeat clicks count once, spam is flagged, and a sign-up that came through two creators is flagged too.

4

Pay the ones who perform
